blackshuck: Black Shuck, an enormous shaggy BLACK DOG the size of a calf standing alone in profile, matted black coat, EYES BURNING RED like coals, heavy paws, head lowered, isolated subject with nothing behind it
chullachaqui: A chullachaqui, an ordinary-looking man in a simple smock standing alone, but with ONE FOOT A DEER HOOF AND THE OTHER TURNED COMPLETELY BACKWARDS, a too-fixed smile, isolated figure with nothing behind it
basajaun: A basajaun, a tall broad forest giant covered in LONG SHAGGY BROWN HAIR down to his feet, a great beard, a kindly weathered face, holding a shepherd's staff, standing alone, isolated figure with nothing behind it
para: A para, a small creature assembled from household objects, its body a WOODEN SPINDLE WOUND WITH TANGLED YARN, twig limbs and a churn-lid face, milk dribbling from its seams, isolated subject with nothing behind it
kapre: A kapre, a very tall dark-skinned hairy giant seated cross-legged, smoking an ENORMOUS CIGAR with a glowing tip, glowing red eyes, a wide belt, relaxed and amused, isolated figure with nothing behind it
asanbosam: An asanbosam, a gaunt long-limbed creature with IRON HOOKS INSTEAD OF FEET, ashen skin stretched over a bony frame, very long dangling arms, a wide mouth of iron teeth, hanging upside down, isolated figure with nothing behind it
